doc: The first-match tutorial (scripts/match/tutorial.gd, TutorialCamps). The hunter lands at level 1 with one ability point and every ability locked, the same as a real run; each pick_<slot> step lets only that slot take a point (its key, the glowing slot or Alt + key) and waits for it, and each camp's kills pay the XP for the next level (camps: the step that spawns it, its monsters, the level its last kill reaches, 0 for none; row = in a line in front of you). steps: [id, the one banner line]. detail: a plain-words second line under it (%L the step's ability in the kit's own words, %X the E ability in words, %R the rank-up keys, %N the E ability's name, %U the ultimate's level, %F interact). %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A the step's ability name; the step's key shows as a key cap beside the line. alt: the line for a variant of a step. labels: the marker's caption per step. mob: how the tutorial's monsters differ from real ones (hp and size up, damage and attack tempo down; camp_hp replaces hp for the camps, so their kills come quickly). fight_foes: the last fight's monsters per starter (the ult step). cds: the share of its usual time every ability, dash and glove cooldown takes here. need: how many times a step's action must land, shown as 1/3 on the pill. 'wayout' is the Ways Out hook: the one step the limited-ways-out work swaps for its own exit beat. retry: the one line shown when you fall into the abyss and the beat starts again (same tokens; default for the steps without one).
steps: Jump at the cliff, then again
Few ways out: reach the Uplink

detail.points: Choose wisely: every level gives one more. Monsters give XP when they fall.
detail.pick_ult: Fuse with %s: one body, its power and yours, for a while.
detail.shoot_draw: Hold the button to draw the bow, let go to loose. A longer draw hits harder.
detail.shoot_melee: Walk up close and tap to swing. Hold to charge a wave.
detail.wallkick: A jump against a wall kicks you up it.
detail.crouch: Crouching shows what lies far ahead.
detail.gkey: %T sends %s at a monster. Tap again to call it back.
detail.glove: Gloves need no points. %Q uses this one.
detail.hook: It shoots from afar. Your glove drags it to your feet.
detail.ranks: Ranks make an ability stronger: %R, or click a gold +.
detail.wayout: A match has only a few ways out. This one is the Uplink at the outpost.
detail.uplink: Stay inside the circle until it's yours. Step out and the capture slips back!
detail.defend: Stay inside the circle. Step out and the capture slips back!

alt.shoot_draw: Hold to draw, let go to loose
alt.shoot_melee: Step in and swing at them

retry.default: Back at your last stop. Try again
retry.dash: Back at your last stop. Dash from the glowing pad
retry.exdash: Back at your last stop. Jump from the pad, then dash
retry.glide: Back at your last stop. Jump, press %J again to glide
retry.sec: Back at your last stop. Use %A away from the edge
retry.shoot: Back at your last stop. Fight with solid ground behind you
retry.gkey: Back at your last stop. Tap %T and let %s go in first
retry.kin: Back at your last stop. Line them up, then use %A
retry.hook: Back at your last stop. Hook the Sentinel with %Q from afar
retry.ult: Back at your last stop. Fuse with %s, then hold your ground
